title: Motorbike with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- back wheel -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="72" r="14" fill="#2b2b4a"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="72" r="13" fill="#3a3a6a"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="72" r="7" fill="#7a7ab0"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="72" r="3" fill="#e0e0ff"/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="72" r="14" fill="#2b2b4a"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="72" r="13" fill="#3a3a6a"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="72" r="7" fill="#7a7ab0"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="72" r="3" fill="#e0e0ff"/>
  <!-- wheel fenders -->
  <path d="M 8 70 A 15 15 0 0 1 36 70" fill="none" stroke="#ffcf40" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 64 70 A 15 15 0 0 1 92 70" fill="none" stroke="#ffcf40" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x="6" y="60" width="18" height="6" rx="3" fill="#c0c0e0"/>
  <rect x="4" y="58" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#e0e0ff"/>
  <!-- body frame -->
  <path d="M 22 62 Q 30 46 50 48 Q 70 46 78 62 L 72 66 Q 68 54 50 54 Q 32 54 28 66 Z" fill="#ff5a5a"/>
  <!-- seat -->
  <rect x="30" y="44" width="30" height="8" rx="4" fill="#ff8844"/>
  <!-- handlebars -->
  <path d="M 72 46 L 84 38" fill="none" stroke="#c0c0e0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="37" r="3" fill="#e0e0ff"/>
  <!-- headlight eye -->
  <circle cx="86" cy="52" r="5" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#fff8cc"/>
  <!-- face on body -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="58" r="4" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="58" r="2" fill="#1a1a3a"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="58" r="4" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="58" r="2" fill="#1a1a3a"/>
  <path d="M 46 65 Q 52 71 58 65" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="64" r="3" fill="#ff6b8a" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="64" r="3" fill="#ff6b8a" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- little antenna -->
  <line x1="50" y1="44" x2="50" y2="36" stroke="#c0c0e0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="34" r="3" fill="#ffcf40"/>
</svg>
